text:
ops-bot: ALERT realtime-slo: p99 streaming latency crossed 4.5s for model=redwood-13B in region=us-east-1. incident_id=INC-2287654321. dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/realtime?p=2287654321
oncall-jordan: I'm taking this (oncall:oncall-jordan). Paging SRE and runtime. @sre-sara @dev-lee @product-maya
sre-sara: grabbing traces now — p95 from ~0.9s -> 1.8s, p99 hitting 4.8-5.2s on streaming endpoints. No spike in 5xx. Looks like chunk emission stalls. Running quick checks (node health + runtime logs).
dev-lee: tailing runtime logs: repeated "emit_chunk_delay=ms:>3000" and occasional "kv_fetch_slow" entries. Also a couple of early OOM-reclaims on a single node.
support-olga: Support report 7789 from BrightCo: customers complaining streaming hangs around 09:14 EDT. Marking BrightCo as impacted.
ops-bot: Severity=P2. Notify policy: oncall -> sre -> eng-runtime. Created channel #incident-2287654321.
oncall-jordan: quick mitigation options: 1) route BrightCo to non-streaming fallback, 2) scale up shared inference pool, 3) temporarily reduce streaming concurrency/batch size. I'll apply one now and follow up.
product-maya: prefer minimal-customer-impact approach first — route BrightCo to fallback or dedicated if available. We'll coordinate comms.
sre-sara: collecting a sample trace:
```
TRACE: start -> kv_lookup(0.08s) -> emit_chunk(0.3s) -> emit_chunk_delay(3.9s) -> emit_chunk(0.2s)
runtime note: wait_for_kv_shard timeout after 4s
```
dev-lee: confirmed hot shard behavior on node compute-07, vm-metrics show memory pressure and frequent GC cycles.
oncall-jordan: routing BrightCo to non-streaming fallback: `rwctl tenant route set --tenant brightco --mode batch-fallback --region us-east-1 --reason "incident-2287654321"` — applied.
ops-bot: Action recorded: route change by oncall-jordan. audit=AUD-2287654321-1
sre-sara: also bumping shared pool by +2 nodes (`autoscale set min=10 -> 12`) to reduce queuing while we diagnose.
dev-lee: adding temporary runtime config patch to reduce max_chunk_size and lower concurrent streams on shared pool:
```yaml
runtime:
  max_chunk_size: 256
  max_concurrent_streams: 180
```
oncall-jordan: patch applied to pool-shared-us-east-1. Observing metrics.
ops-bot: Metrics update in 60s window expected.
sre-sara: after route+scale+patch: p99 for BrightCo sessions dropped from ~5s -> ~1.1s within 70s. Shared pool p99 reduced from ~3.2s -> ~1.4s. Improvement visible on dashboard.
support-olga: BrightCo engineer confirmed perceptible improvement. Ticket 7789 updated with mitigation steps.
product-maya: thanks — please capture root-cause artifacts and keep routing for BrightCo until we confirm fix.
dev-lee: collected heap profiles and KV shard stats, uploaded to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/2287654321/artifacts/. Also instrumented KV latency histograms (new metric kv_latency_p50/p95/p99).
infra-nina: investigating why shard skewed — looks like recent model variant rollout changed key hashing behavior for kernel cache. Opening job to compute shard distribution and rebalance.
sre-sara: immediate follow-ups assigned: eng-runtime (dev-lee) to investigate GC/allocator triggers and patch kernel change; infra (infra-nina) to rebalance shards and add hot-shard alert; oncall-jordan to keep dedicated routing / fallback in place for impacted tenants until postmortem.
oncall-jordan: set watch window 45m. Will stay on-call and monitor traces.
ops-bot: Actions so far: route change, scale-up, runtime patch, artifacts collected. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/streaming-slo-triage
sre-sara: note for postmortem — add test harness for uneven shard distribution and validate kernel changes on canary before rollout.
dev-lee: creating ticket REPRO-2287654321 to run synthetic skewed-shard load and validate mitigation (fallback routing, reduced chunk size).
product-maya: coordinating comms list. We'll proactively notify other high-touch customers without dedicated pools if we detect recurrence.
support-olga: BrightCo will remain flagged until 1h post-stability.
oncall-jordan: final status: live mitigation successful, p99 stabilized ~1.1s for affected streams. Moving incident to "watch". If stable at end of watch, escalate to postmortem and hand off tasks.
ops-bot: Incident watch entered. first_message_ts=2287654321 last_message_ts=2287654980
